title: TypeScript library component diagram
description: @utv/core, the TypeScript library: its source and its tests, the shared conformance material the tests read in place, and what the library and tests depend on outside the repository.

components.name: @utv/core (TypeScript)
components.responsibility: One npm project: the library, its tests and its package files.

components.name: Library source
components.responsibility: The typed layer over the JSON-level everyday API, the text form, validation and native interop.

components.name: Tests and example tests
components.responsibility: The shared fixtures, typed-layer, interop and validation tests, and the UTV-first and native-first example suites.

components.name: Shared conformance material
components.responsibility: The everyday and text-form fixtures, the structural examples and the demo zone rules every library reads.

components.name: Node.js
components.responsibility: The runtime: node:fs for reading files, and node:test and node:assert/strict for the tests.

components.name: JavaScript Date, Intl.DateTimeFormat and JSON
components.responsibility: The language's standard date/time API, which the native adapters bridge and the examples compare with.

components.name: TypeScript compiler 6.0.2
components.responsibility: The only devDependency: compiles src/ and test/ into dist/.

relationships.description: The test suites npm test runs.
npm run build and npm test run tsc -p .
Reads operations/everyday.json, operations/text-form.json, examples/valid.json, examples/invalid-structural.json and rules/demo-zones.json from the repository root.
node --test runs the compiled suites with node:test and node:assert/strict.
The examples compute expected values with Date, Intl.DateTimeFormat (the host's tz database) and JSON.
ZoneRules.load reads the rule file a caller names with node:fs readFileSync.
The native adapters convert to and from Date.
